about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Evoque P250 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Evoque P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine that was introduced in 2016 with the L538 generation facelift and carried over into the current L551 model. This engine is part of Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium family and replaced earlier Ford EcoBoost petrol units in the Evoque range. The P250 sits above the P200 in the petrol lineup, offering higher power output while sharing the same engine architecture. No widely-reported engine issue for this variant — we still recommend a full inspection before any long journey.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200P engines for every Range Rover Evoque P250 on the road.

compatibility.intro: The Evoque P250 uses the same Ingenium AJ200P engine across both L538 (2016-2018) and L551 (2019-present) generations, though there are differences in engine management and ancillary fitment between the two. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
